source.author: verg
source.text: Musa, mihi causas memora, quo numine laeso, quidve dolens, regina deum tot volvere casus insignem pietate virum, tot adire labores impulerit.
source.text_original: Musa, mihi causas memora, quo numine laeso, / quidve dolens, regina deum tot volvere casus / insignem pietate virum, tot adire labores / impulerit.
source.text_english: Muse, remind me of the causes: by what offended divinity, or grieving at what, the queen of the gods drove a man distinguished by devotion to undergo so many disasters, so many labors.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: nate indignos aditure labores, dividimur; nec ad hos animum componere casus ante datum, sed bella tibi terrasque timebam.
reuse.text_original: 'nate indignos aditure labores, / dividimur; nec ad hos animum componere casus / ante datum, sed bella tibi terrasque timebam.
reuse.text_english: Son, who are to undertake unworthy labors, we are being separated; nor was it granted me beforehand to prepare my mind for these misfortunes, but I feared for you wars and lands.
